text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City! Good morn'n!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you supposed to be racing the
Victoria
Mile today?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yep! I'm on my way there now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I see...
...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Um... So how have you been recently?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh you know, I got my nose to the
grindstone!
Why, just last race, I—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know about your record. I'm glad
you're
doing well, but that's not what I
meant.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Don't worry about it. Sorry for
bothering you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: No! You're A-OK! Thanks for ask'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'll see ya when I get back!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Good luck.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: She seems totally fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Look at these racers! You can
really tell the
Victoria Mile's on another
level!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this is totally different from the
Classics.
Everyone here's so composed
and prepared!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
There's Yukino Bijin! Awww, she's cute as
ever!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
But doesn't she appear... a bit different
from the
others? It's like she's unsure of
herself or
something. Is it because of her
new image?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fans A and B
text_block_list.text: Yukinooooo! You're such a cutie!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: A cutie, huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Good luck, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And then, this morn'n I got t'talk to City
a bit!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She must've just finished practice! Can
you
believe my luck?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You betcha!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Actually, I talked to Mifuyu last night.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
My coach agreed to let me follow my
passion.
They even said they'd follow me
to the ends of
the earth!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Practice's gotten super hard recently,
but I'm
stick'n to it! I've gotta keep up
with you, after all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She told me to remember that she's
always with
me, even when we're far
apart.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Anyhoo, the only thing left t'do now is
rush in, full
steam ahead!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
One foot in front of the next!
All righty,
I'm off to the races!
